en: Monochrome, printed postcard-style image of a historic European street with tram tracks curving in the cobblestone road in the foreground. On the left stands a long Renaissance/early Baroque brick building with ornate stone window frames, numerous statues in niches above the windows, and circular medallions along the roofline. A high stone base supports the façade. Several pedestrians in early‑20th‑century clothing walk along the sidewalk near a prominent arched entrance with steps and a small canopy. Adjacent, narrower houses continue the streetscape; distant spires are visible in the background.
